description: Quick PM2.5-centric health recommendation. Pass current PM2.5 (µg/m³) and optionally CO2 (ppm) and VOC index; returns WHO/EPA-aligned bands per pollutant, the overall worst band, and a deduplicated list of plain-language actions. Use this when you have a reading already and just want a 'what should I do?' answer. For richer four-pollutant classification with full source citations use air_health_bands.

co2_ppm.description: Optional. CO2 concentration in parts per million.

pm25_ug_m3.description: Required. PM2.5 concentration in micrograms per cubic meter.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

name: air_health_recommendation
title: Air health recommendation
